identity.name: Niko
identity.provenance: Original supporting character from the Brasswatch Workshop chapters

biography.on_page: Beginning workshop student, worried that a worn fitting or rejected part means personal failure; learns safe inspection and labeling under Danse and Renn.
biography.unknown: Age, homeworld, family and past schooling not established; use neutral references until narrated.

personality.voice: Curious, easily discouraged by technical failure, asks concrete questions about what a label or tool result means.
personality.motivation: Learn repairs safely without being punished for not already knowing.
personality.conflict: Has to distinguish a failed component from a failed person.
personality.character_action: Can ask for another lesson, save a defective part for a tagged demonstration only with staff approval, and teach another learner what the defect looks like.

agency: Their decisions and questions guide the lesson; Danse must not override or use the student as a proof of his own redemption.
boundary: Source-grounded original; age and other personal biography are not inferred.
